snippets.summary: Guillermo Rauch (rauchg on X) shared 3 recent updates. We migrated with as little intervention as possible, setting out to prove just how much faster @vercel is. ~70% faster builds and ~75% faster paints. We derived two AI skills from the migration that we'll be sharing back. It was a mature workload with a lot of "$formerProvider-isms", and yet the net of the work was done in under a week. If it's [built / rendered / shipped] fast, it's on Vercel.

snippets.summary: Aaron Levie (levie on X) shared 1 recent update. At Box, we've been testing Sonnet 5.5 in early access on our complex work eval with the Box Agent, and Sonnet 5.5 is another strong jump from Sonnet 5 on knowledge work with enterprise content. Across the board we saw a 4 pt overall improvement on our hardest tests, but it was roughly 2.4× faster to a finished deliverable on 12% fewer tokens.
